orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: What is parallax error in measurement of length?
orchestrator_output.text_narration: Parallax error happens when you look at a measuring scale from the wrong angle, causing an incorrect reading. When measuring the length of an object with a ruler, your eye must be placed directly vertically above the mark. If you look at the scale from the left or right side, the mark appears to shift away from its true position. To avoid parallax error, place the scale close to the object, keep your eye directly in line above the point being measured, and read the mark straight on.
